question:
Select the Venn diagram that best represents the relationship between mother, father and women.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87b44a5090cfc7713944a67c4f086235d29841bcd7699cfae9f280e5d370636c.png]
solution:
The relationship between Mother, father and Women is as follows:

 
• All mothers are women.
 
• No mother is father.
 
• No women is father.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/52f09b830aa2ecc98ef9f865d6a18ea410c0f4ad7e794565796930eb14e5ef5a.png]
